Laws of the Redemption of the Firstborn

Hilchos Pidyon HaBechor — Halacha Two
segments.he_nikud: כְּשֵׁם שֶׁמִּצְוָה לְלַמֵּד אֶת בְּנוֹ כָּךְ מִצְוָה לְלַמֵּד אֶת בֶּן בְּנוֹ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר, וְהוֹדַעְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְלִבְנֵי בָנֶיךָ. וְלֹא לְבֶן בְּנוֹ בִּלְבַד אֶלָּא מִצְוָה עַל כָּל חָכָם לְלַמֵּד לְתַלְמִידִים וְכוּ' אֶלָּא שֶׁמִּצְוָה לְהַקְדִּים בְּנוֹ לְבֶן בְּנוֹ וּבֶן בְּנוֹ לְבֶן חֲבֵרוֹ, עַד כָּאן לְשׁ

segments.he: ענין בן ובן הבן. ע"פ מ"ש רבינו ז"ל הכ"מ במאמר ויהי מקץ כי מרחמם ינהגם (בלק"ת סי' ז') עני ןבן ותלמיד ע"ש היטב הענין. והכלל כי הארת הבן הוא בחי' איה. בחי' השגת דרי מעלה. והארת התלמיד היא בחי' מכה"כ בחי' השגת דרי מטה וצריך לכלול העולמות עליון בתחתון ותחתון בעליון וכו' ע"ש כל הענין היטב:
segments.en:
· · ✦ · ·

Based upon the discourse beginning Meishra d’sakkina b’mai katli lei etc. (Siman 30) — see there well.

Introduction — The Dales, the Four Kingdoms, and Chesed

It is stated there: that sometimes the aspect of the Dales [the letter dalet] falls — which is the aspect of chochmah tata’ah [lower wisdom], the aspect of Malchus [kingship]. And then the forces of evil have sustenance from there, and from this are formed the four kingdoms, which is the wicked kingdom, the kingdom of Amalek that comprises them all — the aspect of reishis goyim Amalek [the first of the nations is Amalek]. And one must endeavour to cut and separate the aspect of the dalet from them, so that they have no sustenance from there. And this is accomplished through chesed [loving-kindness], the aspect of Avraham. For through this one cuts the aspects of the four — the aspects of Malchus — from them, in the aspect of kitzru l’fi chesed [reap according to kindness] etc. See there.

Section 2 — The Firstborn as Malchus; Giving the Bechor to the Kohen

And this is the aspect of the commandment of the firstborn (bechor) that belongs to the Kohen. For the firstborn is the aspect of Malchus, the aspect of af ani bechor etnenhu [I too shall make him a firstborn], said of King Mashiach. For the firstborn is the first birth, and all births are the aspect of the revelation of His kingship blessed-be-He. For the essential revelation of His kingship blessed-be-He is through the creation of the world, as is known. And therefore the more creatures are born and come into the world, the more His kingship blessed-be-He is revealed. And therefore the firstborn, who is the first birth, is the aspect of the initial revelation of Malchus as mentioned.

For birth is the aspect of the contraction (tzimtzum) of da’as [knowledge] from chochmah ila’ah [supernal wisdom] to chochmah tata’ah [lower wisdom] — through which the birth comes about. It follows that birth is the aspect of chochmah tata’ah, the aspect of Malchus. And the essential [birth] is the first birth, which is the bechor, which is the aspect of the beginning of the revelation. For everything follows the beginning. And therefore the aspect of Malchus is called by the name bechor, in the aspect of af ani bechor etnenhu said of King Mashiach as mentioned.

And therefore when the firstborn is born — which is the aspect of the revelation of Malchus — and at the moment when the revelation of holy Malchus begins, then zeh l’umas zeh [this opposite this], for then the wicked kingdom wishes to prevail and draw sustenance, heaven forbid, from the holy Malchus that is its counterpart. And the wicked kingdom is also the aspect of bechor — the aspect of the kingdom of Esav-Amalek which is bechor. And for this reason Yaakov strove greatly to purchase the birthright from Esav, in order to subjugate the wicked kingdom under the holy Malchus, for the essential Malchus is the aspect of bechor as mentioned. And when he purchased his birthright from him, through this the kingdom of the wicked Esav was nullified, which is the wicked kingdom.

And therefore when a firstborn is born among Yisrael, one must give him to the Kohen. For when the firstborn is born — which is the aspect of Malchus as mentioned — one must then endeavour to separate and cut him from the wicked kingdom, the bechor of the Sitra Achra as mentioned. And this is accomplished through the Kohen, the man of chesed. For through chesed, through this one cuts the holy Malchus from the wicked kingdom, as explained well in the aforementioned discourse. And therefore through giving the firstborn to the Kohen, through this one cuts and separates the holy Malchus — the aspect of the holy bechor — from the wicked kingdom, through the Kohen the man of chesed, in the aspect of kitzru l’fi chesed as mentioned. For the Kohen is the aspect of chesed, the aspect of Avraham, of whom it is said atah kohen l’olam [you are a priest forever].

And this is the aspect of what is brought: that before the firstborn is redeemed, the Sitra Achra has dominion [over him]. And through the redemption one removes him from their domain — that is, as mentioned. For they are attached to draw sustenance from the aspect of the bechor precisely, which was the aspect of Malchus from which comes their sustenance as mentioned. And through the Kohen the man of chesed one cuts and separates him from them, as mentioned.

segments.he: וזהו בעצמי בחי' בן ובן הבן. כי בני בנים הם בחי' לימוד ה' בחי' תלמדיים. כי בני בנים הם נו"ה כמובא בכוונות על ומבאי גואל לבני בניהם. ונו"ה זה בחי' לימודי ה' בחי' איה שהוא בחינת דרי מעלה. ותלמיד שהוא רחוק יות על כן השגתו בחי' מכה"כ שהיא בחי' השגת דרי מטה שהם רחוקים יותר שצריכין להאיר בהם בחי' מכה"כ. וזהו בחינת בן ובן הבן כי מחמת שבן הוא רחוק יותר מן הבן. ע"כ השגתו בערך הבן הוא בחינת השגת התלמיד בחינת מכה"כ. מאחר שכבר נשתלשל בהשתלשלות יותר ונתרחק במדירגה יותר מן הבן. וע"כ הוא שלימות גדול כשזוכה החכם ללמד את בנו ואת בן בנו תורה. כי אזי נעשה כלליות גדול בשלימות גמור של בן ותלמיד. כי זוכה שהבן ותלמיד שניהם נמשכים ממנו ונכללים בו כי בנו ובן בנו הם בחי' בן ותלמיד כנ"ל ושניהם נכללין בו שהוא אבי האב בחי' זקן שזהו בחי' כתר שהוא בחי' זקן כידוע. שזהו בחי' השגת החכם בעצמו שזוכה לשפע הכתר שהוא מאיר בבן ותלמיד כמבואר שם במאמר הנ"ל. נמצא שנעשה כלליות גמור בשלימות גדול ונכללין בן ותלמיד דהיינו הבן ובן הבן. ומקבלין ויונקים משרשם שהוא אבי אביהם שהוא החכם והזקן שזוכה לשפע הכתר ששם נכללין בן ותלמיד כנ"ל וכמובן במאמר הנ"ל. ועל כן בן בנו קודם לבן חבירו כי בן בנו שהוא תלמיד הוא בשליטמות יותר מתלמיד אחר. כי גם התלמיד צריך שיהיה נכלל בבחינת בן כמבואר שם. אבל הבן הבן שהוא בחי' תלמדי כנ"ל הוא נכלל ביותר בבחי' בן. מאחר שנמשך ממוח החכם בעצמו והוא בן הבן על כן הוא נכלל יותר בבחינת בן וזהו עיקר השלימות שיהיה נכלל בן ותלמיד ביחד וזה שארז"ל כל שהוא ת"ח ובנו ת"ח ובן בנו ת"ח שוב אין התורה פוסקת מזרעו לעולם שנאמר לא ימושו מפיך וכו' כי עיקר קיום התורה שלא תשתכח הוא על ידי כלליות בן ותלמיד שהואכלליות העולמות דרי מעלה ודרי מטה וכנ"ל כי זה עיקר השלימות כשנכללין העולמות יחד העליון בתחתון וכו'. וזהעיקר החים שהוא התורה שכלולה מהשגת בן ותלמיד שהם כלליות כל התורה כולה. כי עיקר החים הוא שהנפש דהיינו הדעת הוא מקושר בהגוף וגוף ונשפ הם בחינת דרי מעלה ודרי מטה וכשנקשרין ונכללין יחד זה בחי' חיים שהוא בחי' קישור העולות וכללותם יחד. אבל כשאין העולמות נכללין יחד ח"ו זה בחי' מיתה שנסתלק הנפש מן הגוף ח"ו. מחמת שאין קשר בי ןעליון ותחתון וזה בחי' שכחה שהוא בחי' מיתה כ"ש רבינו ז"ל (סי' ל"ז) כי שכחה היא הסתלקות הדעת שנסתלק הדעת מהגוף. ואין השכל והדעת שהיא הנשמה מקושר בהגוף וע"כ שכחה היא בחי' מיתה ח"ו. כשרז"ל כל השוכח דבר אחד וכו' כאלו מתחייב בנפשו וכו' ועל כן כשזוכה שיהיה הוא ובנו ובן בנו ת"ח שוב אין התורה נשכחת מזרעו מאחר שנכלל בן ותלמיד בשורשם בשלימות גמור כנ"ל. עלכן התורה מתקיימת בזרעו ואינה נשכחת מהם עוד מאחר שנכללו העולמות דהיינו בן ותלמיד שהם בחינת דרי מעלה ודרי מטה בחי' נפש וגוף שזהו בחינת חיים בחי' זכרון היפך השכחה ועלכן התורה מתקיימת בהם ואינהנשכחת. כיעיקר קיום התורה ע"י כלליות בן ותלמיד שהם כלליות כל התורה כולה. כיעיקר הדעת שהוא התורה הואבחי'ב' השגות אלו של בחי' בן ותלמיד שהוא כלל כל התורה שהוא הדעת. וז"ש בכלליות התורה והודעתם לבניך ולבני בניך. כי זה כלל כל התורהבחינת הארת הבן ובן הבן שהם בחי' בן ותלמיד שזהו בחי' כלליות התורה כנ"ל. וז"ש השמר לך וכו' פן תשכח את הדברים וכו' ופן וכו' והודעתם לבניך ולבני בניך כי על ידי שמאיר בבן ובן הבן שהם בחינת בן ותלמיד. שזהו בחי' כלליות העולמות דרי מעלה ודרי מטה נפש וגוף בחי' חיים על ידי זה ניצול משכחה שהוא בחינת הסתלקות הדעת בחינת מיתה כנ"ל שזהו בחי' שאין כלליות וקשר בין עליון ותחתון וכנ"ל. וזה שכתבו התוספות על מאמר הנ"ל כל שהוא ובנו וכו' ת"ח וכו' והוא שרואין זא"ז כי זה עיקר השלימות כשרואין זה את זה והבן ובן הבן שניהם מקבלין ויונקים מאבי אביהם שהוא בחינת הזקן שבו נכללין שניהם יחד עליון ותחתון בן ותלמיד. ואזי כשנכללין אלו הג' יחד דהיינו הבן ובן הבן שהם בחינת בן ותלמיד נכללין שניהם יחד בבחי' הזקן שהוא אבי אביהם שיונק משפע הכתר ששם הוא כלליות כולם כנ"ל ואז ינעשה כלליות גדול בשלימות גדול ואזי נעשה חוט המשולש כי הם נכללין יחד בכלליות גמור כמו חוט משוזר כי נעשה כולו חד. מאחר שהבן ותלמיד שהוא בן הבן נכללין יחד בשרשם באבי אביהם ששם הם נכללין יחד כי שם בן ותלמיד כולו חד. ואזי ע"י הכלליות זה מתקיימת התורה לעולם. כי זה עיקר קיום התורה והדעת ע"י כללו בן ותלמיד כנ"ל:
segments.en:
Section 3 — The Five Shekalim: Rectifying Wealth and Cutting Off the Sitra Achra

And this is the aspect of the redemption (pidyon) with five shekalim that are given to the Kohen. For it is stated there in the aforementioned discourse that the essential means of meriting the aspect of chochmah tata’ah — the aspect of Malchus mentioned above — is through hating monetary gain (sonei betza), for one must hate money with ultimate hatred etc., see there. For the essential sustenance of the wicked kingdom comes through the desire for money, for from there is their essential nourishment — from wealth that is not in holiness — as is also explained elsewhere.

And therefore when one wishes to redeem the firstborn from the Kohen, one must then rectify one’s money and wealth — which is the aspect of Malchus — so that the Sitra Achra should have no sustenance from the aspect of Malchus through the money. For their essential sustenance is from there. And therefore one must give money to the Kohen. And through this one breaks the desire for money by taking one’s money and giving it to the Kohen. And through this very act one also rectifies the money and wealth — which is the aspect of Malchus — by giving the money to the Kohen. For the Kohen rectifies money and wealth, since he is the man of chesed who cuts the holy Malchus from the Sitra Achra through chesed.

And therefore this money and wealth that comes into his hand from the Yisrael — that is, the five shekalim that the Kohen takes — immediately when the money comes into his hand it is cut and separated from the Sitra Achra, from the wicked kingdom, through chesed as mentioned. And when the money and wealth — which is the aspect of Malchus, from which the essential sustenance of the wicked kingdom comes through wealth that is not in holiness as mentioned — is rectified: then immediately when the wealth is rectified the firstborn returns to Yisrael. For now it is already permitted for the firstborn to be in the possession of the Yisrael, since they have no sustenance from the aspect of the firstborn’s Malchus through the five shekalim he gave to the Kohen, through which the money and wealth were rectified and cut and separated from the Sitra Achra, from the wicked kingdom. And now they no longer have sustenance from the holy Malchus, the aspect of bechor, for their essential sustenance is through the wealth as mentioned.

Section 4 — Five Shekalim = the Letter Heh; Twenty Silver = Two Yuds United

And therefore one must give five shekalim precisely. For Malchus is the aspect of heh [the letter heh, numerically five] as is known. And when Malchus is in exile, heaven forbid, and they draw sustenance from it, it is in the aspect of dales — the aspect of poverty and indigence — for the wealth is blemished, heaven forbid, and they draw sustenance from there, heaven forbid, and the wealth flows to them, heaven forbid. And then the holy Malchus is in the aspect of poverty and indigence, the aspect of dales.

But when the wealth and Malchus are elevated to holiness, then it is the aspect of heh, for all the wealth and all the influences return to holiness. And when Malchus is in the aspect of wealth, then it is the aspect of heh. And this is the aspect of the five shekalim given to the Kohen, for through this the wealth returns to holiness through the Kohen the man of chesed, who cuts the dales from the wicked kingdom. And then Malchus is in the aspect of heh, in the aspect of wealth, in the aspect of va-harikosi lachem berachah ad b’li dai [and I will pour out for you a blessing without limit].

And this is the aspect of twenty silver (esrim kesef). For the five shekalim given to the Kohen are twenty silver — this being the aspect of the rectification of the holy Malchus, the aspect of chochmah tata’ah that ascends from the wicked kingdom through the Kohen the man of chesed. And then chochmah tata’ah is joined with chochmah ila’ah, from which is the essential sustenance of chochmah tata’ah, as is explained and understood in the aforementioned discourse. And when chochmah tata’ah and chochmah ila’ah are joined together, this is the aspect of twenty silver. For they are two yuds [each yud = ten] — the aspect of asarah asarah ha-kaf [ten ten the kaf], as is known.

Section 5 — Rashi on the Five Shekalim; Yosef’s Sale; the Exodus and Plunder of Egypt

And this is what Rashi explains regarding the reason for the five shekalim of the redemption of the firstborn: thus was the sale of Yosef, for twenty silver, since he was the firstborn of Rachel etc. For the commandment of the firstborn was given to Bnei Yisrael immediately upon their going out from Egypt. For the essential Exodus from Egypt depended on this: to subjugate the bechor of the Sitra Achra and to bring out from there the holy bechor. For the essential exile of Egypt began through the sale of Yosef, who was the firstborn. And through this they brought, as it were, the holy bechor — who is the aspect of the holy Malchus — into the exile of Egypt. And particularly because they sold him for twenty silver and blemished the wealth, as mentioned.

And therefore through this precisely the matter unfolded and they descended to Egypt, for they gave power to the kingdom of Egypt, the wicked kingdom, through selling to them the holy bechor who is Yosef as mentioned. And therefore it was impossible for them to leave until Hashem struck all the firstborn of Egypt, in order to subjugate the bechor of the Sitra Achra that was drawing sustenance from the holy bechor — from which came their essential power as mentioned.

And therefore when they left, Moshe himself took the bones of Yosef with him. For in this depended the essential redemption: through returning and bringing out the holy bechor — the aspect of Yosef — from the wicked kingdom. And what Yisrael took of the wealth of Egypt and all their riches is all one aspect, for they are all one, and the entire essential redemption depended on this. For the essential redemption comes through subjugating the wicked kingdom, the bechor of the Sitra Achra, and elevating from there the holy Malchus which is the aspect of the holy bechor, the aspect of Yosef. And then one must bring out all the wealth from the Sitra Achra and bring it into holiness, as mentioned.

And as our Sages of blessed memory said: all of Yisrael were occupied with the plunder, and Moshe was occupied with the bones of Yosef. For in truth it is all one. For what Moshe took — the bones of Yosef, the holy bechor returned and brought out from the wicked kingdom — and what Yisrael took — the wealth of Egypt and all their riches — is all one aspect. And the entire essential redemption depended on this. For the essential redemption comes through subjugating the wicked kingdom, the bechor of the Sitra Achra, and elevating from there the holy Malchus which is the aspect of the holy bechor, the aspect of Yosef. And then all the wealth must be brought out from the Sitra Achra into holiness, as mentioned.

And therefore it was then a great commandment to take the plunder of Egypt, and Hashem blessed-be-He warned them greatly about this, as explained in the verse there. For it is the aspect of rectifying the holy Malchus, on which the essential redemption depends, as mentioned. And therefore when they left Egypt they were immediately commanded the commandment of the firstborn — to redeem him with twenty silver, just as was the sale of Yosef through which they descended into the wicked exile of Egypt. Correspondingly, in reverse: at every time when a firstborn is born, and one must ensure that the wicked kingdom should have no sustenance from there, heaven forbid, one must give twenty silver to the Kohen, the man of chesed. And through this one cuts the holy Malchus from them in the aspect of kitzru l’fi chesed as mentioned.

Section 6 — Opening the Womb; Bechor Peter Kol Rechem

This too is the aspect of what Rabbeinu explains there in the aforementioned matter in another place: that through this the womb of a woman in difficult labour (makshah leileid) is opened, in the aspect of daltei vitni [the doors of my belly]. And this is the aspect of chatcho l’arba [cutting it into four] — see there and understand well. And this is the aspect of bechor peter kol rechem [the firstborn that opens every womb] that one gives to the Kohen the man of chesed. For through chesed is accomplished the aspect of chatcho l’arba, through which the birth takes place. And the essential birth is the first birth, for the essential is the beginning. Understand this well.

Baruch Hashem l’olam, Amen v’Amen.
